attractions.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
attractions.description: Active volcano rising to 1,717 metres above sea level offering one of Bali's most spectacular sunrise experiences. Panoramic views across Lake Batur, Mount Abang, and Mount Agung on clear days.
attractions.recommended_duration: Approx. 2 hours ascent and 1.5 hours descent

attractions.name: Batur Natural Hot Spring
attractions.description: Warm mineral-rich waters set against a backdrop of volcanic peaks and tranquil lake views. Soothing experience for tired muscles with fresh mountain air.

attractions.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Jeep Experience
attractions.description: Journey across Mount Batur's black lava fields by 4WD jeep. Arriving before dawn, witness the first rays of sunlight illuminate the surrounding mountains, Lake Batur, and dramatic volcanic landscape.

attractions.name: Kintamani Volcano Viewpoint
attractions.description: One of Bali's most spectacular viewpoints offering panoramic views of the majestic Mount Batur volcano and the vast crater lake below. Features cool mountain air and dramatic volcanic landscape.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Kintamani Coffee
local_dishes.description: Grown in the fertile volcanic highlands surrounding Mount Batur, known for its smooth body, mild acidity, and subtle citrus notes.

safety_tips.tip: Temperatures at the Mount Batur summit can feel surprisingly cool before sunrise — carry a light jacket or fleece.

For Mount Batur, wear comfortable trekking shoes, a light jacket or fleece, cap and sunglasses, and carry a small backpack with water and snacks. Temperatures at the summit can be cool before sunrise.
